title: MSN Messenger Message
blurb: Pure early-2000s, and barely a second of it. MSN Messenger's new-message alert was the sound of somebody wanting to talk to you, and for a generation of teenagers it was the most important noise in the house — closely followed by the nudge, which shook the entire window and started genuine arguments. Messenger peaked at hundreds of millions of users before Microsoft folded it into Skype in 2013. Play it today and anyone who ever wrote their status in alternating capitals will look up immediately.
origin: The new message alert from MSN Messenger.
